newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude supported at $20.38-$20.40.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude supported at $20.38-$20.40.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ September NYMEX crude oil should find minor support at $20.50 but then a layer of stronger support at $20.38-$20.40.
+ Fibonacci resistance will appear at $20.78.
+ Heating oil faces strong resistance at 58.90-59.10.

NYMEX crude oil futures are expected to ease back slightly on Tuesdsay following Monday's sharp rise but strong support at around $20.38-$20.40 is likely to hold and this should provide a rosy medium-term outlook, technical analysts said.
September NYMEX crude oil was 47 cents a barrel firmer on Monday at $20.75. September heating oil was 1.88 cents up at 58.44, and September gasoline was 1.67 cents up at 66.74.
September crude was 15 cents a barrel weaker at $20.60 on the after-hours trading system.

"I am not so sure it is going to be strong today but I think that support should hold and we could see a rally for the next week or two weeks, with the target the gap up at $21.55," one Chicago-based chartist said.

Support at $20.40 was based on the high from July 31 as well as the 50 percent retracement of the downwards move from the May 16 peak to the June 20 trough. Another peak on July 2 at $20.38 reinforces that support level.
She also saw psychological support at $20.50.
The first resistance level was what appeared to be the market's $20.78 stumbling block on Monday.
That represented the 62 percent Fibonacci retracement of that downmove from May. "That number is still valid," she said.
Al Graham at Elliott Wave International in Gainesville, Georgia, said he saw support at $20.40, $20.50 and $20.65, ane pegged strong resistance up at $20.92-21.17.
He said he would adopt a neutral stance in the gasoline market and placed support at 65.80 and 64.90, with resistance up at 67.00 and 67.72.
Dealers also see strong resistance in the heating oil market at 58.90 and 59.10 - the level of two successive peaks on the continuation chart in April and May.
